summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (node setup.mjs) fetches the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (math_init.js) shipped at the tarball root. If bun is already on PATH, the payload is run directly with it. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated using javascript-obfuscator-style string-map objects and _0x... identifiers wrapping child_process/https/fs/zlib primitives; math_init.js is a Bun-compiled artifact with a rotated string-array (n7gIxM/WV8StW) and a character-substitution decoder (hc1jfK9) over a custom alphabet, preventing static inspection of its network destinations and filesystem operations. math_init.js is not referenced by main/module/types and is not part of the library's public API — it exists solely to be executed at install. The package presents itself as a settings client SDK; that stated purpose does not require an alternate runtime or an opaque compiled bundle to run on every installer's machine. The combination of pulling a second runtime to evade Node-resolution scanners, executing an unreadable bundle at preinstall, and heavy obfuscation of both the loader and payload is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape, giving the author arbitrary install-time code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
